notes.title: Devilish Lady Doctor – Now Released!
notes.content:
The wait is over! The fifth installment of the DomiHorror series, Devilish Lady Doctor: A Night of Domination and Allure, is now officially released.

Set in a haunting hospital, this title immerses players in a world where fear and seduction intertwine. Step into the twisted mind of a deranged lady doctor who manipulates her victims with charm and cruelty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381921/cd1ae9d62a2f44c44b19723f81d21477c60f51ae.png[/img]

Key features:

Immersive Storytelling: Experience a thrilling narrative filled with suspense and unexpected twists.

Tactical Gameplay: Hide, evade, and outsmart the doctor in her deadly games.

Striking Visuals and Atmosphere: A chilling hospital environment that enhances the tension and fear.

Will you survive the doctor’s madness and uncover the truth behind her sinister desire? 

Find out today in Devilish Lady Doctor!

Download now and step into the most intense chapter of the DomiHorror series yet!

notes.title: Devilish Lady Doctor - A Night of Domination and Seduction -
notes.content:
Enter the twisted world of 狂鬼の女医 ～支配と魅了の夜～  - A Night of Domination and Seduction -, the highly anticipated 4th installment in the DomiHorror series to be released on January 25th!

Set in a hauntingly atmospheric hospital, the story follows a deranged lady doctor whose twisted sense of justice intertwines control and seduction. With her gaze fixed on you, survival is only possible if you outsmart her sinister taste.

Experience immersive gameplay that combines intense suspense, clever mechanics, and hauntingly seductive encounters. This chapter promises a gripping narrative and pulse-pounding horror that pushes the boundaries of the DomiHorror universe.
